params.name: exitFormula
params.description: Expression converted into a formula and pushed onto the current method or function's exit stack.

overloads.semanticRole: Registers an expression to execute when the current method or function exits, including return, error and user-abort exits.

constraints: Introduced in 21 R4; deferred expressions execute in LIFO order.
Local variable values are captured when defer is encountered; objects and collections retain reference semantics.
A defer inside a deferred expression raises an error.
Errors raised by deferred expressions are intercepted and ignored by 4D while the remaining exit stack continues.
